findings.text: non-blocking: the guard the reuse repair added keys on two exact global identifier names, SPECIES in globals() or family_template in globals(), so a second species list named SPECIES_NAMES, an inlined tuple, or a re-implemented family template under another name passes the check it was added to enforce, leaving the drift the census module owns undetected.

non-blocking: the coverage check compares the report's stated with_score_after (158) against len(with_after) from the progress records, so it passes at 158 of 173 while the done_when clause requiring a score beside every worked name is still unmet for 44 records with no score_before and 15 with no score_after; the report now discloses the gap but no assertion requires the clause.

non-blocking: the Outcomes paragraph still states the below-floor count as accepted names, but held is built by skipping every accepted record at :545 and the clause added at :754 states that the 7 below-floor names are all among the 23 held, which verify at :1468 asserts, so the delivered HTML contradicts itself in the same section.

non-blocking: the durability assertion is a manual verify phase of the evidence script, invoked only from the run-directory gate/run_repair_checks.sh, so nothing in tests/ or CI runs it and a stale report reddens no automated check.

item_verdicts.diff: read both repair commits in full against 7a0a1ce89 plus the full-run diffstat from aa6e7e5: ac6f1f555 deletes the local SPECIES list and family_template and delegates operator_of to the census module's OPERATORS, and 2cd7b6e0 adds the 40-check verify phase, the score-coverage paragraph and the score-floor and spend clauses.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for the committed html and json with per-family and per-operator forms before and after re-read from the live graph, every worked name with before and after text and scores, every left name with a reason, sourceless live names not above 10 and spend at most USD 30; gate-logs/repair-checks-1318172.log runs the script's verify phase and prints 40 PASS lines with checked 40 mismatched 0 and EXIT=0, covering the counts, the bound, the ceiling, the score coverage and the worked and left accounting, but not the per-name text and score completeness clause.
item_verdicts.goal: the reviewed run's goal is to bring the species families and operator names to the one stored wording on the live graph; family-wording-pass.json census_after records one_wording_count 0 of 23 families and divergent_count 23, species departing 39 against 76 before and operator omissions 6/4/1/0/3, so the family clause is unachieved and the operator half is reduced rather than settled.
item_verdicts.manifest: read the reviewed run's manifest.md; it reports status complete, names all five commits, cites gate-logs/repair-checks-1318172.log as both tests and negative_control_log with 40 of 40 counts matched and both controls failing for their named reason, and carries no baseline_suite or after_suite key, so added_failure_count is 0 and added_failure_ids is empty.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the four declared paths are the family-wording-pass .json, .html and .py and docs/figures/sn-family-wording-pass; git diff aa6e7e5..2cd7b6e0 changes exactly those four files (24,170 insertions) and the repair commits ac6f1f555 and 2cd7b6e0 touch only the same four files (329 insertions, 136 deletions).

justifications.durability: family-wording-pass.py:1379 adds a verify phase that reddens on a stale count, and the gate's reuse control shows it failing on the reverted script, but no test in tests/ or CI step invokes it, so the guard fires only when a human runs a phase that needs the live graph.
justifications.evidence: gate-logs/repair-checks-1318172.log prints 40 PASS lines and checked 40 mismatched 0 with EXIT=0 against a live re-read, and both negative controls fail on the line each names, but family-wording-pass.py:1466 checks the stated score coverage rather than the done_when's every-name clause.
justifications.fit: family-wording-pass.py:1404 follows the module's existing check-and-print shape and reuses the census module's measures, and the added argparse phase matches the sibling fragment generators' surface.
justifications.goal_fidelity: family-wording-pass.py:664 records the family clause as 0 of 23 before and after because no family carries a stored sentence, so the goal's family clause does not move under this change.
justifications.reuse: family-wording-pass.py:120 and :125 now take SPECIES, family_template, OPERATORS, family_census and operator_census from rewrite-closing-census.py's module loaded by census_module(), extending the owner that already implements the measure.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 7a0a1ce89..2cd7b6e071 changes only the four declared evidence and figure paths, and no graph write appears in the landed code.
